skipBuyPhase.label: Skip the buy phase
skipBuyPhase.note: Playback jumps to the moment each round opens. Scrubbing into a buy phase by hand still takes you there and still shows it.

seekStep.label: Seek step
seekStep.note: How far the left and right arrow keys move the clock.

heldArrowRate.label: Held-arrow rate
heldArrowRate.note: How much faster a held arrow key moves than a tapped one.

radarTheme.label: Radar theme
radarTheme.note: Which set of map images the plate draws. Which one is better is settled by looking at ten players on top of both.

audibility.label: Audibility rings
audibility.note: A ring around each player showing how far their movement carries. It is the largest mark on the plate, and it is an approximation of the game's own falloff.

playerNames.label: Player names on the plate
playerNames.note: The name beside each living player. Turning it off leaves the team cards as the way to tell who is who.

trajectories.label: Grenade trajectories
trajectories.note: The flight path a grenade leaves behind it. Narrowed to the selected player, it draws nothing until you pick one.

scoreboard.label: Scoreboard position
scoreboard.note: On the timeline it costs the plate nothing. Over the map it floats above the players, which is the one thing allowed to cover them.

survivors.label: Round strip survivors
survivors.note: Two tracks under the round numbers, showing how many players each side had left. The same control sits on the strip itself.

language.label: Language
language.note: Game words — map names, weapons, callouts — are never translated.

motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.note: Follows the device unless you answer here. What moves with the match is drawing rather than animation, and is unaffected either way.

palette.label: Colour-blind-safe palette
palette.note: Both side colours and every mark on the plate, chosen so that no two stay close under red-green colour blindness.

debug.label: Debug overlay
debug.note: Map, frame, drawn level, and the world coordinate under the pointer. Built for working on the tool rather than on a match.
